result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with a functional food delivery layout. One minor styling inconsistency was found in the favorite/heart button treatment across cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons in the 'Popular right now' section are styled inconsistently. The Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white/light circular background for the heart icon, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency (e.g., use a semi-transparent dark overlay or consistent white circle on all).
